name: Backup
description: Safety copies of Nuxiva's state (settings, memory, projects, automations): compressed archives with a SHA-256 fingerprint, verifiable and downloadable, created by hand or at regular intervals.
capabilities: Compressed state archive, with permissions reserved to the system only
SHA-256 fingerprint to verify the archive has not been altered
Keeps only the latest backups, deleting the oldest
Download and deletion from the panel
